text:
In the Sky mora a espíritu,
cuyas cuerdas of the heart son a laúd;
ninguno canta mejor, ni with tal frenesí
as the ángel Israfel,
and the estrellas vertiginosas,
así it afirma the leyenda,
deteniendo his himnos,
escuchan the encantamiento of his voice,
all in silence.
Dudando in it alto of his meridiano,
the luna apasionada is sonroja of love,
mientras, for oírle, the mismo rayo
(and with él the veloces Pléyades)
is detienen in the sky.
And dicen that the fervor of Israfel
is debe to the sortilegio of his lira,
to the trémulo alambre vivo of his cuerdas;
where the pensamientos profundos son a deber,
where the Love is a God already anciano,
where the eyes of the huríes
brillan with the adorada belleza of the astros.
Tienes razón, Israfel,
in despreciar all canto that not sea apasionado.
¡A ti the laureles, bardo the mejor
and the more sabio!
¡Larga and gozosa life for ti!
The altos éxtasis caen with the ardientes notas,
with your pain, your joy, your odio, your love,
the fervor of your laúd.
¿Qué there is of extraño in that the estrellas
eternas permanezcan mudas?
Sí, tuyo is the Sky,
but este is a world of dulce amargura,
nuestras flores son only flores,
and the shadow of your inmensa beatitud
is the light of nuestro sol.
If I pudiese habitar in the reino of Israfel,
and él in where I habito,
not podría the ángel cantar a melodía terrenal,
mientras I, in cambio, podría lanzar to the firmamento
a nota more plena that esta sad canción
that brota of my lira.
